## Summary

- State the problem and the bounded change introduced by this pull request.
- Reference the linked issue (for example, `Closes #<issue-number>`).

## Changes

- List the concrete module, schema, CLI, MCP, or documentation updates.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (syntax, JSON schemas, `index.d.ts` parity, skills, and local Markdown links/anchors).
- [ ] `npm test` passes with deterministic regression coverage for changed behavior.
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.ko.md` remain aligned if user-facing behavior or CLI flags changed.

## Boundaries & Compatibility

- Note any trust bundle, journal schema, verification plan, or host protocol impacts.
- Distinguish local deterministic test results from live host observations.
